preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 9 and 1 <= bi <= 9 and ai != bi for ai, bi in employees)
preconditions.description: Each employee's initial floor ai and destination floor bi must be between 1 and 9, and ai must not equal bi.
The number of employee entries must match the specified number n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal possible time in seconds to deliver all employees to their destinations.
